commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: prep dir"
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/pki/local-ca
cd /etc/pki/local-ca

echo "STEP: generate CA key"
sudo -n openssl genrsa -out ca.key 4096 2>/dev/null
sudo -n chmod 600 ca.key

echo "STEP: generate CA cert"
sudo -n openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key ca.key -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -subj "/CN=OS Comparison Root CA" \
  -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:true" \
  -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" \
  -out ca.crt

echo "STEP: verify cert subject"
openssl x509 -in ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates

echo "STEP: install into system trust store"
sudo -n cp ca.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
sudo -n update-ca-trust extract

echo "STEP: verify trust installed"
trust list | grep -A2 "OS Comparison Root CA" || true

echo "STEP: verify openssl trusts it standalone (leaf test)"
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/ca-trust/extracted/pem/tls-ca-bundle.pem ca.crt || true
